name: Footprint gate and archboard-plan skill
summary: model footprint --fail-outside fails a branch that changes a module outside its draft, and init installs the archboard-plan skill that runs this gate before each ticket merge.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk#5pa5C2WH
changes.value: The executable embeds the program at its paths in the repository, which is why the installation names a program root. The grammars of the code check, the reviewed texts of the workbench and the theme colours are embedded, so the package holds no file that the program finds beside its source. Beside the executable it copies the frontend bundle, the core with its glue bundled with the panic guard, and the archboard, archboard-pr and archboard-plan skills. It writes archboard-release.json with the version, the commit, the hash of the core sources and the Codex version. The flake's build names the commit in ARCHBOARD_RELEASE_COMMIT, because its source has no .git, and the Bun runtime of each target in ARCHBOARD_RELEASE_BUN_RUNTIMES, because its sandbox cannot download one. Otherwise the commit is the checkout's HEAD, and Bun downloads the runtime. It refuses a bundle that would load a native addon at run time, a checkout with no frontend build, and a core built from other sources than the checkout's.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/XppR9owz#XgeEM0Pb
changes.value: TASK-601, in place of install-skill (TASK-471.03). The skills CLI (skills.sh), started by bun x, pnpm dlx or npx, installs the archboard, archboard-pr and archboard-plan skills of the installation globally for Codex, and for Claude Code when claude is on the PATH. A person at a terminal picks the runner or skips; a caller without a terminal gets the first one found. Then the repository setup makes the vault at the root of the git checkout that holds --repo, else the working directory, and registers the checkout. Choosing and installing a language server depends on the repository, so init leaves it to an agent: at a terminal it starts Claude Code or Codex, as the person picks, with a prompt that has the agent confirm its plan first; without a terminal its answer ends with that prompt in next, for the agent that ran it. It writes nothing into the installation, CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/XppR9owz#MrE3v2T6
changes.value: The command passes explicit local source refs and selected architecture to the existing history interface. Proposal comparisons use their identified baseline. With --fail-outside and a draft, it exits 1 when the commits changed a module that the draft does not name, so a ticket merge without a pull request has the same gate as the pull-request Action; without a draft it refuses the option.
